method: fal: full catalog https://api.fal.ai/v1/models (paged, 1,527 active endpoints on 2026-10-22; 105 dated 2026-09-15 or later), then 225 endpoint ids (catalog hits plus guessed ids) probed at https://fal.ai/api/openapi/queue/openapi.json?endpoint_id=<id>: 153 served a schema, 72 did not (listed in gaps). Schemas parsed by the same rules as part 3 (refs resolved, anyOf-null -> nullable, nested item/field schemas kept, output schema kept as outputFields); price = '## Pricing' of https://fal.ai/models/<id>/llms.txt; title, licence and status from ?endpoint_id= catalog lookups (unlisted = schema served but no catalog entry). The parser was checked against parts 1-3: 58 re-fetched endpoints reproduced their recorded inputs, with the drift listed in gaps. Replicate: search API https://replicate.com/api/search, the newest-models feed https://replicate.com/api/latest-models?page=1..12, and each model page's embedded dereferenced_openapi_schema, billingConfig and latest version (38 pages fetched). Higgsfield: https://dash.higgsfield.ai/api/v2/pricing/models/?page=1..4 compared with higgsfield-api.json, and per-model https://dash.higgsfield.ai/models/<id>/llms.txt for the new family. World Labs: https://docs.worldlabs.ai/api/reference/openapi.yaml and https://docs.worldlabs.ai/api/pricing.md. Licences of community models from the upstream LICENSE files or Hugging Face model cards. Bria's mask polarity was inferred by measuring Bria's own example mask video with ffmpeg. conventions.operation: Part 1-3 values plus: erase-video, inpaint-video, segment-video, swap-video, insert-video, character-swap, v2v, ref2v, motion-transfer, interpolate, sdr-to-hdr, upscale-video, utility, ocr, detect, vlm, image-to-splat, image-to-3d, image-to-world, image-to-pano, angles, depth, t2v, i2v, keyframes2v, t2i, edit, t2svg, vectorize, tts, avatar, reframe, outpaint.
conventions.inputs: JSON-schema const values are recorded as a one-value enum. Otherwise the same per-field shape as part 3 ({type, required, default, values, valueType, minimum, maximum, minimumExclusive, minLength, maxLength, minItems, maxItems, nullable, desc, examples}; arrays of objects carry itemSchema/itemRequired, arrays of enums items 'enum' + itemValues, objects fields/fieldRequired, unions variants).
conventions.keyFields: Fuobe canonical slot -> exact field name, as in parts 2-3 (dotted = nested). Slots new in part 4 are listed in newKeyFieldSlots. scripts/gen-cloud-models.py's build_route does not read them; studio code should read them from the route's research record, as with part 3.
conventions.output: Main result path; outputShape = one-line summary per top-level output field ('object<Video|File>{...}' marks a union of two file shapes); outputFields = full output schema (fal, Higgsfield and World Labs records).
conventions.pricing: price = the vendor's own sentence (fal llms.txt '## Pricing', Replicate billingConfig tiers, Higgsfield llms.txt, World Labs pricing page); pricing = {usd, unit, note} for the default tier. 'compute-second' at $0 means fal lists the app as compute-billed without a public rate. Replicate community models have only a note.
conventions.status: fal: active = in https://api.fal.ai/v1/models; deprecated = catalog status deprecated (still served); unlisted = schema served but no catalog entry; playground-only (new) = in the catalog with a schema, but the model page says API access is not open yet (Kling 4.0). Replicate, Higgsfield, World Labs: active.
conventions.providers: fal and replicate as in parts 1-3. New: 'higgsfield' (Genjutsu Light; same request lifecycle as higgsfield-api.json, which gen-higgsfield-models.py reads, so copy these into that file to use them) and 'worldlabs' (World Labs Marble API: header WLT-Api-Key, async operations; Fuobe has no provider for it yet).
conventions.replicateCommunity: As in part 3: community models are recorded as 'owner/name:<version>' and POST /v1/predictions {version, input}; billed by GPU time.
conventions.reverified: Records whose notes start with 'Part N endpoint, re-verified 2026-10-22' repeat an endpoint from parts 1-3 with the current schema, outputFields and new key-field slots. gen-cloud-models.py merges them over the older record exactly like part 3 (keyFields merged, everything else replaced).
conventions.capability: Grouping used by paid-model-apis-4.md: erase | swap | finish (interpolation, HDR, codecs, upscalers) | videoutil | ocr | scene3d | frontier.

An OpenAI customer story (openai.com/index/higgsfield-longer-videos-voice, dated 2026-10-13 in search results) says Higgsfield uses 'GPT-6 Astra' for videos over ten minutes. It is not on fal, Replicate or Higgsfield's public API, and the page returned 403 to WebFetch: unverified.
